info.biography: 三国时期吴国官员陆绩之女。13岁嫁同郡张白，3月后，张白因兄张温一族的案件连坐，处以流刑，死于流放地。陆郁生言不再改嫁，困难于生计但拒绝了所有提亲，在艰苦中从未停止服侍、照顾张白的姐妹。事情传到朝廷，皇帝褒奖陆郁生，号其为“义姑”。
info.characteristic: 考验对牌堆底的控制力及敌友的留牌方案。

锁定技，摸牌阶段开始时，你展示牌堆底三张牌并摸与其中红桃牌数量等量张牌。
当你每回合首次受到伤害时，你展示牌堆底三张牌并弃置其中任意张牌，此伤害-X（X为以此法弃置的红桃牌数）。

implementationInferences.explanation: The locked before-damage opportunity is spent by its first accepted attempt in the actual turn, including an attempt fully reduced to zero; actual earlier positive damage and the issued opportunity fact survive skill loss/regrant. This is an engine timing interpretation, not a dedicated official FAQ.

Reveal up to the three entities actually present at the bottom without drawing, shuffling, or repositioning them. Drawing uses the native top. The reduction counts only actually discarded original Hearts; zero or non-Heart discards are legal. Paid native movement/HP/recovery/death children complete without paying twice after source loss.

The wounded participant is the actual Discard owner. The skill owner chooses draw or discard; the participant privately chooses an actual HE discard if possible. The phase adjustment is not conditional on obtaining one card or being able to discard one card: an empty deck draws zero but still gives -1, and empty/un-discardable HE forces zero discard but still gives +1. The text contains no 若如此做 condition. The issued adjustment lasts only for that exact actual Discard phase and survives subsequent source loss or recovery to full HP.

The initial reduced final damage naturally becomes the native propagated base. A reduction applied locally to a later chained recipient is restored before advancing to the next living recipient, including a native redirected current recipient. This follows the engine recipient-scoped damage contract, not a dedicated official FAQ.
